name: ragforge-monorepo
description: Open-Source, Self-Hosted Knowledge Base & AI Agent Platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=@ragforge/server & npm run dev --workspace=@ragforge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@ragforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@ragforge/server && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@ragforge/shared && npm run build --workspace=@ragforge/server && npm test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e --workspace=@ragforge/web
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run bundle --workspace=@masterdeepak15/ragforge && npm pack --workspace=@masterdeepak15/ragforge --pack-destination .

author: Deepak & Claude
